title: Quiz: MLOps, Serving, Observability, and Technical Debt

questions.question: Which statement best captures MLOps in machine learning systems?
options: It applies operational discipline to the ML lifecycle from development through monitoring.
It ends once a model endpoint returns predictions.
It can ignore data and feature pipelines.
It needs no rollback plan if validation accuracy improved.
